character: 130 km, beautiful Haute-Savoie village, excellent mountain restaurants, authentic. 45 min from Geneva.
name: La Clusaz
description: 220km of linked pistes, 55 lifts, across the Aravis massif. A single-resort domain (La Clusaz town at 1,200m, with villages Les Confins, Paccaly, and Le Nant). Known for: one of the most beautiful church squares in the French Alps, consistent snow from Aravis altitude, and excellent cross-country skiing on the Aravis plateau (extensive Nordic area). 1 hour from Geneva. Popular with weekend skiers from Geneva. Lively apres, family-friendly.
